assessments.reasoning: The five verified publisher slices distinguish covered files from separate other material. Reading [6944,7146) continuously with [7146,7621) preserves the opening of the second sentence on the first slice's last line. Its Secondary License conditions govern the additional permission.

challenge.method: Tested a combination with a separate, independently written file under a non-Secondary License. Then tested an attempt to apply the chosen whole-work terms so as to displace the MPL requirements for the covered component.
challenge.results: The non-Secondary License does not defeat the first permission. It supplies no basis for the additional licensing permission in the following sentence. Displacing the covered component's MPL requirements would fail the first permission's express condition.

limitations: Section 1.7 requires separate other material outside Covered Software. Rights in that other material must be assessed independently.
reasoning: The first sentence of section 3.3 permits chosen terms for a Larger Work while preserving MPL requirements for the Covered Software. The second sentence introduces additional licensing of the covered component under separate conditions.
